independence_evidence: Published by the magazine's own company at 10 Golden Square, London (contact page); the about page describes 10 and 10 Men as its own London-based titles; no large media group named anywhere on the site. Web search results suggest the legal entity is Zac Publishing Ltd, an indie media group owned by the editor-in-chief.
qualifies_reason: Independent London fashion biannual with Issue 64 (Autumn/Winter 2026) on newsstands since 25 September 2026.
what_it_is: 10 Men is a large-format menswear fashion magazine from London, published twice a year to match the men's collection seasons. Each issue is built around a themed set of words (Issue 64 is 'Future, Legacy, Heritage') and mixes long fashion shoots, cover stories with actors and musicians, and interviews with designers and craftspeople, with several collectible covers per issue. It suits readers of luxury menswear and fashion photography rather than general men's lifestyle.
